commands.name: annotations.list
commands.summary: Subtitle/segment annotations, OP/ED and derived samples of a source.

commands.name: app.prepareQuit
commands.summary: Number of active jobs that quitting would cancel.

commands.name: app.quit
commands.summary: Cancel jobs and stop Core.

commands.name: assets.get
commands.summary: One sound asset.

commands.name: assets.listForSource
commands.summary: All sound assets of a source, full tracks first.

commands.name: assets.tracks
commands.summary: Tracks that can be default tracks, with roles and current defaults.

commands.name: core.hello
commands.summary: Core version, workspace and schema version.

commands.name: dev.registerStem
commands.summary: Dev hook: register an existing stem file as a full-track asset (S1.2).

commands.name: dictionary.check
commands.summary: Validate user dictionary text line by line (no compiling).

commands.name: dictionary.preview
commands.summary: Phonemes and readings of one sentence with a draft (or the current) dictionary.

commands.name: dictionary.save
commands.summary: Compile the user dictionary in a job; on success it becomes active atomically (undoable, rejected if changed meanwhile).

commands.name: edits.apply
commands.summary: Apply an edit batch atomically (undoable).

commands.name: edits.peekUndo
commands.summary: What undo would revert next.

commands.name: edits.preview
commands.summary: Validate an edit batch and show its changes without writing.

commands.name: edits.undo
commands.summary: Undo the latest edit that can be undone safely.

commands.name: exports.range
commands.summary: Export an asset range as WAV named by the naming rule (+ fragment word).

commands.name: exports.samples
commands.summary: Export samples as WAV files for drag-out (original, or stretched per sample); returns file paths.

commands.name: exports.stretched
commands.summary: Export a whole sample as a stretched WAV at the global BPM (scheme computed on demand; manifest with the composed mapping).

commands.name: exports.wav
commands.summary: Export an asset range as a WAV file (reuses an identical export).

commands.name: flatten.estimate
commands.summary: Estimate the target from cached measurements only (no model run).

commands.name: flatten.open
commands.summary: Open the flatten workbench: freeze asset + outer selection, entry defaults, alignment availability, suggested name.

commands.name: flatten.rerunFailed
commands.summary: Re-queue only the failed items of a flatten job with the same options.

commands.name: flatten.results
commands.summary: Per-item results of a flatten job (product sample and target).

commands.name: flatten.submit
commands.summary: Queue one flatten (checks the frozen asset is unchanged).

commands.name: flatten.submitBatch
commands.summary: Queue a batch flatten: one job, each sample targets independently (auto only).

commands.name: hits.export
commands.summary: Export a hit as WAV (original, or stretched with its evidence scheme).

commands.name: hits.render
commands.summary: Render a hit for audition: stretched with the scheme its evidence chose (whole scope rendered, hit range cut out), or original with clicks.

commands.name: hits.resolve
commands.summary: Check that a hit is still valid and return its range and evidence scheme (09 §9.7).

commands.name: imports.commit
commands.summary: Register the scanned files (optionally with full-length samples).

commands.name: imports.preview
commands.summary: Preview of a finished import scan.

commands.name: imports.scan
commands.summary: Scan files/folders to import (background job).

commands.name: jobs.cancel
commands.summary: Cancel a queued or running job (kills its whole process tree).

commands.name: jobs.list
commands.summary: Recent jobs, newest first.

commands.name: jobs.retry
commands.summary: Retry a failed, cancelled or interrupted job as a new job.

commands.name: jobs.submit
commands.summary: Submit a job of a registered kind (low-level; prefer the specific commands).

commands.name: measure.f0
commands.summary: FCPE pitch/confidence/energy frames of an asset range (unmeasured frames are NaN).

commands.name: metrics.prepare
commands.summary: Queue a job that measures missing F0 and computes the single-sound metrics for the current scope.

commands.name: metrics.status
commands.summary: Single-sound metrics in the current scope: prepared count and, per chosen metric, how many samples lack it (they never match).

commands.name: models.probe
commands.summary: Submit a job that runs one minimal inference per model under the current device setting.

commands.name: models.status
commands.summary: Model files, ONNX Runtime and inference probe status.

commands.name: models.verify
commands.summary: Submit a job that hashes the model files.

commands.name: oped.add
commands.summary: Mark or confirm an OP/ED range (undoable).

commands.name: oped.delete
commands.summary: Delete an OP/ED range (undoable).

commands.name: oped.identify
commands.summary: Identify OP/ED from subtitle rules; applies non-overlapping pairs when there are no errors.

commands.name: oped.identifyMany
commands.summary: Batch OP/ED identification.

commands.name: oped.list
commands.summary: OP/ED ranges of a source.

commands.name: peaks.get
commands.summary: Waveform peaks for an asset range (pending while the cache is built).

commands.name: playback.resolveAsset
commands.summary: Playback handle for auditioning an asset range (file seconds).

commands.name: playback.resolveRender
commands.summary: Playback handle of a rendered audition (by key, never by path).

commands.name: playback.resolveSource
commands.summary: Playback handle for the source player (file, audio track, external stem).

commands.name: reaper.handoff
commands.summary: Copy WAVs to the REAPER folder and build the REAPERMedia clipboard text: unbaked original + stretch markers, or (baked) stretched audio + onset markers.

commands.name: reaper.template
commands.summary: Write the same items as an .RTrackTemplate file (experimental).

commands.name: results.close
commands.summary: Close a fixed result (deletes the result set only, never samples).

commands.name: results.list
commands.summary: Open fixed results (restored without searching again).

commands.name: results.page
commands.summary: One page (at most 100) of a fixed result; only checks members for invalidation, never recomputes or reorders.

commands.name: results.setUi
commands.summary: Remember a fixed result's UI state (active, page, selection, scroll).

commands.name: rhythm.bpm
commands.summary: Global target BPM (null = original-speed stretch).

commands.name: rhythm.render
commands.summary: Render an audition (original or stretched; voice, voice+click or click only) into the rebuildable cache.

commands.name: rhythm.setBpm
commands.summary: Set the global target BPM (20-400 or null); a working parameter, not undoable; broadcast as rhythm.bpm.

commands.name: rhythm.setParams
commands.summary: Edit per-sample rhythm parameters (pause sensitivity, segment threshold, splits, manual cells/cuts/merges); undoable.

commands.name: rhythm.view
commands.summary: Rhythm analysis of one sample: blocks, pauses, segments, cells and the three schemes at the global BPM (computed on demand, no model run).

commands.name: roots.add
commands.summary: Add a source folder (adopts sources already inside, then scans).

commands.name: roots.list
commands.summary: Source folders.

commands.name: roots.relocate
commands.summary: A whole source folder moved: re-point its sources by relative path, then scan.

commands.name: roots.remove
commands.summary: Stop treating a folder as a source folder (sources stay).

commands.name: samples.create
commands.summary: Create a sample on an asset range (always a new sample).

commands.name: samples.delete
commands.summary: Delete samples (assets, measurements and exports stay).

commands.name: samples.get
commands.summary: One sample with its effective tags.

commands.name: samples.ids
commands.summary: IDs of all samples matching the filter (select all across pages).

commands.name: samples.list
commands.summary: One page of samples matching the filter, with the total.

commands.name: samples.suggest
commands.summary: Suggested name and nature for a new sample on an asset range.

commands.name: search.cancel
commands.summary: Cancel a running search (a cancelled search writes no fixed result).

commands.name: search.coverage
commands.summary: How much of the current browse scope is ready to search (speech index built / F0 measured).

commands.name: search.pitch
commands.summary: Start a complete pitch search (saved samples or analysed source tracks); finishes with event search.finished and a fixed result.

commands.name: search.pitchCheck
commands.summary: Validate a pitch query (blocks or the text helper format) and return on-the-spot problems; no search.

commands.name: search.prepare
commands.summary: Queue a job that prepares the search index for the current scope (speech: rhythm index; pitch: F0). Does not search.

commands.name: search.speech
commands.summary: Start a speech/rhythm search on the current scope; finishes with event search.finished and a fixed result (all hits kept).

commands.name: search.status
commands.summary: State of a search started in this session.

commands.name: separation.results
commands.summary: Assets registered by a separation job.

commands.name: separation.submit
commands.summary: Separate an asset (range) with a Studio model; reuses identical results.

commands.name: settings.list
commands.summary: All settings with value, default and version (edit via edits.apply, entity 'setting').

commands.name: sources.add
commands.summary: Register source files (each succeeds or fails on its own).

commands.name: sources.delete
commands.summary: Delete a source with its assets, samples and annotations (not undoable).

commands.name: sources.deletePreview
commands.summary: What deleting a source would remove.

commands.name: sources.get
commands.summary: One source with its streams.

commands.name: sources.inferTest
commands.summary: Try the work/episode inference rules (draft or current) on a file name.

commands.name: sources.list
commands.summary: All sources with per-source counts.

commands.name: sources.prep
commands.summary: Preparation checklist state of one source.

commands.name: sources.relocate
commands.summary: Point a source at a moved file (reports changed streams, does not refuse).

commands.name: sources.rescan
commands.summary: Scan all source folders for new, moved or missing files.

commands.name: sources.wholeSamples
commands.summary: Create one full-length sample per source on its default track.

commands.name: speech.forAsset
commands.summary: Current alignments of all samples on an asset range (same physical audio only).

commands.name: speech.preview
commands.summary: What a speech analysis would do: M to analyze, N up to date (skipped), K blocked with reasons.

commands.name: speech.results
commands.summary: Per-item results of a speech analysis job.

commands.name: speech.sample
commands.summary: Speech analysis of one sample: alignment text, current head with phonemes, all versions.

commands.name: speech.saveManual
commands.summary: Save edited phoneme times as a new manual version (times only; labels/order fixed; rejected if the version changed).

commands.name: speech.submit
commands.summary: Queue a speech analysis job (inputs frozen now; one process for all items).

commands.name: speech.submitRange
commands.summary: Analyze an asset range with a given text segment (no sample needed).

commands.name: speech.switchHead
commands.summary: Make another successful version the current one.

commands.name: studio.status
commands.summary: PyMSS Studio installation and model list (submits a listing job when unknown).

commands.name: subtitleSamples.create
commands.summary: Create samples from chosen subtitle lines (atomic).

commands.name: subtitleSamples.preview
commands.summary: Preview creating samples from subtitle lines or sound effects.

commands.name: subtitles.import
commands.summary: Import subtitle markers from a preview (insert only, atomic, undoable).

commands.name: subtitles.importMany
commands.summary: Batch subtitle import, each source atomic on its own.

commands.name: subtitles.preview
commands.summary: Preview importing subtitle markers of one source.

commands.name: subtitles.previewMany
commands.summary: Batch preview of subtitle import (sources without subtitles are skipped).

commands.name: subtitles.ruleTest
commands.summary: Try the subtitle rules (draft or current) on one subtitle text.

commands.name: tags.promoteBatch
commands.summary: Edit batch that promotes local tags to a segment tag (apply with edits.apply).

commands.name: thumbs.get
commands.summary: List thumbnails (pending while generated).

commands.name: ui.get
commands.summary: Restore UI state of one page.

commands.name: ui.set
commands.summary: Save one UI state value (not user data, no undo).

commands.name: works.list
commands.summary: Work folders (first-level subfolders of source folders).

commands.name: works.rename
commands.summary: Rename a work: renames the folder on disk (not undoable).

commands.name: works.settingsBatch
commands.summary: Edit batch for a work's settings (apply with edits.apply).

DerivedSample.title: DerivedSample
DerivedSample.description: 派生采样车道（R7.6）：起止为原片秒。

EditOp.title: EditOp
EditOp.description: 一条编辑：``op`` 缺省为 update（要 ``id`` 与 ``version``）；create 只要 ``fields``。字段与取值由编辑通道逐条校验。

ErrorWire.title: ErrorWire
ErrorWire.description: Core 的错误：错误码 + 参数（界面按当前语言生成提示）。

ExportRangeParams.title: ExportRangeParams
ExportRangeParams.description: 时间：资产局部秒。words：导出文件名的固定词（音轨名、flatten、fragment「 · 片段」、local「局部」），随界面语言。

F0Frames.title: F0Frames
F0Frames.description: F0 帧（10 §10.1）：float32 小端序列；没测的帧为 NaN。第 i 帧中心 = t0 + i × step（资产局部秒）。

FlattenPhone.title: FlattenPhone
FlattenPhone.description: 输入局部秒（外选区起点 = 0）。

FlattenToken.title: FlattenToken
FlattenToken.description: 打开拉平台时冻结的音源与外选区（资产局部秒）和存放它的文件快照（指纹字符串）；提交时核对。

HitInfo.title: HitInfo
HitInfo.description: 核对过仍有效的命中（资产局部秒）；plan/bpm = 证据所选的方案（不限节奏 = 近快、当前 BPM；音高命中没有卡拍）。

HitRefParams.title: HitRefParams
HitRefParams.description: 固定结果里的一处命中：结果、行（rank）、行内第几处。

IdentifyManyRow.title: IdentifyManyRow
IdentifyManyRow.description: 批量识别的一行：出错时只有 sourceId + error，否则同 IdentifyResult。

JobDevice.title: JobDevice
JobDevice.description: 提交时冻结的设备设置（13 §13.1.2）。

MetricFilter.title: MetricFilter
MetricFilter.description: 单音 · 音色 / 瞬态的即时筛选（10 §10.3）：缺少所选指标的采样不命中。

ModelProbe.title: ModelProbe
ModelProbe.description: 实测记录（14 §14.7）：passed 带各 EP 执行的节点数，failed 带原因。

Peaks.title: Peaks
Peaks.description: 波形峰值；``min``/``max`` 是 float32 小端序列。``start`` 为资产局部秒。

PitchChecked.title: PitchChecked
PitchChecked.description: 就地提示：problems 为空才能查找。text = 规范的文本格式（复制用）；blocks = 文本解析出的块（粘贴用）。

Prep.title: Prep
Prep.description: 准备清单的现状（UI_PLAN §4；没有顺序、不强制）。

PromoteInfo.title: PromoteInfo
PromoteInfo.description: 本地标签提升为区段标签（R5.6）：编辑批次与它的作用域；不写库。

ReaperParams.title: ReaperParams
ReaperParams.description:
REAPER 交接（12 §12.3）：多条 = 依次排开、间隔一小节。baked：卡好拍的声音 + 起音拉伸标记 / false = 未烘焙原声 + 卡拍拉伸标记 /
    不给 = 按设置 export.reaper_kind（⌘C 用）。

ResultHit.title: ResultHit
ResultHit.description: 一处命中。语音：start/end 资产局部秒，first/count 是音块；音高：start/end 资产局部秒，frames、octave、ratio、blocks〔每块：帧数, 带内可靠帧, 平均距离（音分）〕，原片模式另有原片秒。

ResultRow.title: ResultRow
ResultRow.description: 固定结果的一行。state：ok / deleted（采样已删除）/ changed（音源已变化）/ stale（分析或测量变了：命中已失效，请重新查询）。

RhythmBlock.title: RhythmBlock
RhythmBlock.description: 一个音块（资产局部秒）与逐音属性（未知为 null）。

RhythmPhone.title: RhythmPhone
RhythmPhone.description: 采样范围内的音素（资产局部秒）；拆点“在第 k 个音素之前”按这里的序号。

SearchCoverage.title: SearchCoverage
SearchCoverage.description: 范围的检索准备情况：ready = 可以检索；stale = 要先「准备当前范围索引」；noAnalysis = 没有可用的语音分析（语音检索里计入“缺少有效分析”）。

SearchFinished.title: SearchFinished
SearchFinished.description: 事件 ``search.finished`` 与 ``search.status`` 的内容。status = running / done / cancelled / failed。

SeparationSubmitted.title: SeparationSubmitted
SeparationSubmitted.description: 同输入同模型已有结果时只返回 ``reused``（各声部资产 ID），否则返回任务。

SpeechBlockCond.title: SpeechBlockCond
SpeechBlockCond.description: 语音检索的一个音块条件（09 §9.6.3）；留空 = 不限。节奏策略下 note 必填。

SpeechPhone.title: SpeechPhone
SpeechPhone.description: 一个音素（资产局部秒）。``orig`` = 前端给的原标签（清音 I/U）；``eff`` = 有效范围；``strength`` = 起音强度 0–1。

SpeechPreview.title: SpeechPreview
SpeechPreview.description: 确认框：将分析 M 条；N 条已是最新，跳过；K 条无法处理（原因）。

StretchedExportParams.title: StretchedExportParams
StretchedExportParams.description: 卡拍 WAV（只能完整采样，12 §12.1）。mora / longVowel：舞台上的临时纯 mora（不保存）。

SubtitleBatchRow.title: SubtitleBatchRow
SubtitleBatchRow.description: 批量预览的一行：没关联字幕（skipped）、出错（error）或可导入（其余键）。

SubtitleImportManyRow.title: SubtitleImportManyRow
SubtitleImportManyRow.description: 批量导入的一行：出错时只有 sourceId + error，否则同 SubtitleImportResult。

WorkFolder.title: WorkFolder
WorkFolder.description: 作品文件夹：原片文件夹的第一层子文件夹。
